The paper prints no section numbers at all, so every place is built from the heading tree printed on the Contents page and marked unnumbered. Numbering is complete and conventional: five tables print "Table N." and five figures "Figure N.", and the only repeated number is Table 1's, printed again on the continuation page. Caption placement is split by exhibit type - every table caption sits above its grid and every figure caption below its art. Table 1 breaks across the page 6/7 fold with its caption and header row repeated, so it is counted once with continued=true and the continuation is excluded. All five tables share one house form: an outer frame, a rule under the header band, no internal vertical separators, and grey banding on alternate rows; Tables 2 and 3 are the same twelve-row template re-run with and without India, significant variables set in bold, and Table 4 is the one transposed grid (years as columns, two year bands as the heads, only two data rows) and the only one whose unit appears solely in the caption. All five figures are pasted raster exports of R plots: Figures 1 and 2 share one style (open-circle scatters with "X vs. Water Access, 2012" panel headings), Figure 2 is one six-panel figure exported in two stacked rasters whose row-1 axis band is duplicated across the seam and whose last panel is a boxplot rather than a scatter, Figure 3 is a single scatter with an unnamed red fit line and no coefficient printed on the art, and Figures 4 and 5 are intervention line charts whose y ceilings differ (98 against 96) although they share axes and styling. Citation is complete: every one of the ten printed numbers is pointed at at least once - Table 1 three times (twice on page 6, once again on page 9), Table 5 twice inside one paragraph on page 14, and Figure 1 twice (on page 5 and again on page 7) - so the only row without a mention is the second raster of Figure 2, which shares the one citation Figure 2 gets.
rules: 全文没有一个节号，标题只靠层级与字号区分：section_path 因此按 Contents 页印出的层级逐级拼出，并以“未编号标题”前缀标记，section_numbered 记 false。[place.section_path]
表题在上、图题在下，逐行按纸面判：5 张表的题注都印在网格上方（position=above），5 张图的题注都印在图下方（position=below）。[caption.position]
跨页表只计一次：Table 1 在 P6/P7 折页处断开，续页重复印刷题注与整行表头且三列宽度不变，故 P6 记 continued=true，P7 那一半作为 split-across-pages 排除，而不是记成第二张表。[table.continued]
一个图被导出成两块 raster 时按行记两条：Figure 2 的六面板分印在 P7 上下两块里，题注只印在下块之下，因此题注记在阅读顺序第一行，第二行 caption_source=none 并在备注写明题注印在下块。[caption.verbatim]
线型与斑马纹按目视记：5 张表都是外框加表头横线、没有内部竖线，记 boxed 并在备注说明无竖分隔；5 张表全部隔行灰底，记 zebra=true。[table.rule_style]
单位位置照实记：Table 5 把 "Access to Water (% of Population)" 写在表头（units_in_header=true），Table 4 的单位只出现在题注里、网格内无处可寻（false），Table 1 另设 Units 列（false）。[table.units_in_header]
header_rows 没有 0 值可记：Table 4 是把年份当列头的转置网格，两段 "Year" 带即列头，记 header_rows=1 并在备注写明表头与行首 "Year" 同行。[table.header_rows]
引用次数按编号出现次数逐处数，不按句子数：Table 1 3 次（P6 两次、P9 回指一次），Table 5 2 次且都在同页，Figure 1 2 次（P5 首次、P7 重提），其余每件 1 次。[mention.count]
